title: Do you have any laundry facilities we can use?

post.title: Do you have any laundry facilities we can use?
post.html: There is a communal laundry room which guests are welcome to use. It includes 2 washing machines, a tumble dryer and ironing equipment.

description: Guests are welcome to use the communal laundry room, with two washing machines, a tumble dryer and ironing equipment.
